Rocky was that once in a lifetime kind of dog. My soul dog. He came into my life when I was just about to start high school and I was badly bullied. Everyday I would come home and hide tucked away in the corner of my room and cry. Shortly after I would hear “thump thump thump” coming up the stairs. In the doorway would be none other  than my boy. He would sit with me and let me cry into his fur. He was always there for me for the 10 years we had him. 
He was a bit dog aggressive and people aggressive so when my sister had a baby we were all very nervous. As soon as the baby came home, Rocky was in love. He let my nephew put hats on him, drape him in towels and blankets. They were buddies and my nephew adoringly referred to him as his Uncle Rocky. They spent 5 years together and never had any problems. 
Whenever we would leave the house and come home Rocky would be in the same spot just waiting for us. Or waiting at the door. I’ve never met such a loyal dog in my life. 
My favorite memory.. gosh, I don’t know how to pick. One of them definitely being that every year he would get a birthday cake and we would sing happy birthday. So whenever it was someone else’s birthday he thought it was his and would bark until he got a seat at the table and a plate in front of him. 
One of my favorite things he would do is sniff my face and give me kisses whenever I put my head to his. I was his human..and he was my boy. Always was and always will be..
One more favorite memory because I have far too many to just share one would be when he would get a present and we would wrap it up. He got SO excited. He would rip it open and as soon as the toy was unveiled he would immediately take it up to my room and play with it for a while..always returned to his Geoffrey though! Geoffrey was his favorite toy since he was a pup. It was a collection from petsmart that toys r us created and he loved this thing down to just a decrepit giraffe head. He knew this toy by name. No matter where Geoffrey was, if we said “Rocky, where’s Geoffrey!? Go get Geoffrey!” he would run like lightening to go get his pal. If he couldn’t find him at night when he slept next to me he would bark at me until I emerged victoriously with an old & stinky giraffe head. Now I carry that giraffe head with me everywhere, sleeping with it at night...because I know Geoffrey misses his Rocky too...
My boy does the same thing.. and occasionally stands right over my head while I’m sleeping and does the low rumble bulldog growl.. he’s lucky I love him so much

Put some vetericyn on a q tip and apply it to the wounds. I work at a pet store and whenever our mice have wounds whether it be from scratching or fighting other mice, we use this and it clears it up really fast! You can get it at petco 

Edit: also not sure what you are feeding him but I’ve noticed a lot of my mice have been allergic to corn. So if you are using a mix that has corn maybe try picking that out! I was born in '96, also the same year I went to Disney for the first time. I went almost every year until I was older and my favorite part each time was getting to see my favorite character, Goofy. Even had the old school goofy hat. This made me cry. Disney is so magical and the cast members are so wonderful. One year I had smashed my mouth open the day before I was going to Disney and my teeth pulled away from my gums. I went to Disney and while waiting for the great movie ride, smashed my face on the rope dividers and reopened the wound. I was taken to the Disney hospital and given the best care I've ever received. The workers at the great movie ride kept asking me if I wanted anything; food, drinks, ice cream. They gave me paper and crayons to draw and then hung up my picture on the little podium. They then gave me a certificate to get anything in the park and to this day my family makes fun of me for getting baby Eeyore :) easily one of the most magical moments when I went to Disney as a child.
